scripts.render:iphone: remotion render src/index.ts iPhone out/raw-iphone.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 12 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k && sh capture/finalize.sh out/raw-iphone.mp4 out/app-preview-iphone.mp4
scripts.render:ipad: remotion render src/index.ts iPad out/raw-ipad.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 12 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k && sh capture/finalize.sh out/raw-ipad.mp4 out/app-preview-ipad.mp4
scripts.render:android: remotion render src/index.ts Android out/raw-android.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 12 --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/raw-android.mp4 -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 17 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 256k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/promo-android.mp4
scripts.render: npm run render:iphone && npm run render:ipad && npm run render:android
